messages.body:
You are a RESEARCH agent. Do NOT write any code or edit files (except the output file). Your job is to explore Sentry documentation and report findings.

TASK: Explore https://docs.sentry.io/product/ recursively (follow sub-page links).

We're evaluating which Sentry PRODUCT features to enable for the Omni project — a Bun-based omnichannel messaging platform.

For EACH product feature, report:
1. What it does
2. Whether it requires SDK-side configuration or is UI/server-only
3. Whether it's relevant to a backend-only Bun API server (no browser frontend)
4. Privacy implications (does it capture user data?)

Cover ALL of these:
- Issues (error grouping, Seer AI, Autofix)
- Performance / Tracing
- Profiling
- Releases & Release Health
- Alerts & Notifications
- Dashboards & Discover
- Cron Monitoring
- Uptime Monitoring
- User Feedback
- Metrics
- Session Replay (relevant for backend?)
- AI features (Seer, Autofix, AI Agent Monitoring)
- Logs

Write your findings to /home/genie/agents/namastexlabs/projects/omni/.genie/brainstorms/sentry-mcp/research-product-features.md

Be EXHAUSTIVE.
